entities.summary: Hannibal TV is a Tunisian television network. It has been broadcasting since 2005. The channel ceased operations on July 3, 2019. The channel resumed operations on October 2, 2020, but it was ceased operations again on October 29, 2020. The channel has been resume operations again from December 28, 2021.
